study: F2 WP2.6: hidden modules (MEAS-13) - landmark optical fixes and a barycentric delta-DOR with the IERS consensus quasar delay
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md WP2.6; finding MEAS-13; owner decision 2026-11-06: fix the landmark module, fix delta-DOR now

survey_before_predeclaration.landmark: PA vs ME landmark position 163-875 m on the surface (up to 56 px at 100 km); analytic Jacobian vs FD with the camera DCM held fixed 3.6e-11, vs FD with the nadir DCM rebuilt from the perturbed position 5.8% median (6.1% max, 40 geometries); principal point convention 0.5 px
survey_before_predeclaration.delta_dor: Goldstone-Canberra and Madrid-Canberra, 15 epochs: module D_S (Moon-centred Newtonian) vs an SSB Newtonian reference on geocentric time 69-92 ns; module D_Q (static plane wave) vs IERS 2010 eq. 11.9 geometric 675-1048 ns; delta-DOR 606-957 ns; typical precision 0.1 ns

design.body_frame: landmark_inertial_position_m and landmark_surface_outward_normal_j2000 take body_frame; allowed exactly 'MOON_ME_DE440_ME421' (default, the frame of LOLA-derived catalogues) and 'MOON_PA_DE440'; computed as pxform('J2000', body_frame).T @ r_body
design.attitude_source: pinhole_position_jacobian takes attitude_source: 'external' (default; DCM is an independent input, e.g. star tracker; unchanged) or 'nadir_from_state' (DCM = perturbed_camera_frame(nadir_pointing_camera_frame(r_sc), attitude_bias_rad); the analytic dC/dr term is added; the passed DCM must equal that construction to 1e-12 or ValueError)
design.pixel_origin: CameraIntrinsics.pixel_origin: 'corner' (default; principal point W/2, pixel i spans [i, i+1]; unchanged) or 'center' (principal point (W-1)/2, pixel i centred on i, the OpenCV convention)

gates.G1_nadir_jacobian: attitude_source='nadir_from_state' analytic d(u,v)/dr vs central FD (1 m step) with the DCM rebuilt at each FD point: relative Frobenius error < 1e-6 on the survey's 40 geometries, without and with a fixed 1 mrad alignment bias. Before the fix the only Jacobian is 5.8% off
gates.G2_external_unchanged: attitude_source='external' (and the default call) bitwise equal to the function before the change on the same geometries
gates.G3_body_frame: default body_frame equals pxform('J2000','MOON_ME_DE440_ME421').T @ r_body bitwise; body_frame='MOON_PA_DE440' bitwise equal to the function before the change; outward normal equals position / |position| to 1e-15; ME vs PA displacement inside the survey band [100, 1000] m
gates.G4_frames_fail_closed: 'MOON_ME', 'MOON_PA', 'IAU_MOON' and any other string raise ValueError
gates.G5_pixel_origin: 'corner' projections and FOV flags bitwise equal to before; 'center' principal point is (W-1)/2 and u, v are exactly 0.5 px smaller than 'corner' (to 1e-12 px)
gates.G6_nadir_consistency: attitude_source='nadir_from_state' with a DCM that is not the nadir construction (5 mrad off) raises ValueError

design.quasar_term: relativistic_light_time.quasar_delay_consensus: IERS Conventions (2010) eq. 11.9 geometric delay with T_grav (eq. 11.1 form, bodies configurable, default Sun and Earth), in station TT, b the geocentric baseline at the reception at A, V the Earth's barycentric velocity, w2 station B's geocentric velocity, U the Sun's potential at the geocentre; the station clock convention of delta_dor_station_time (tag at A read as t + b_A; the measured delay carries b_A - b_B)
design.observable: relativistic_light_time.delta_dor_ssb: delta_dor_station_time(...) delay minus quasar_delay_consensus on the same tags and clocks; requires station_time='FULL_TOPOCENTRIC' (ValueError otherwise) and both sites; partial = delta_dor_partial of the station-time solution (the quasar term does not depend on the spacecraft)
design.legacy: delta_dor.quasar_differential_delay_s / delta_dor_observable_s / solve_common_transmit_event unchanged bitwise, labelled legacy_synthetic (Moon-centred, static baseline; self-consistent synthetic studies only) with the survey magnitudes

gates.G7_consensus_vs_bcrs_oracle: quasar_delay_consensus without gravity vs a first-principles oracle in the test: plane wave from K in SPICE TDB/SSB coordinates, station positions X_E + x - (V.x)V/(2c^2), arrival at B solved by fixed point, TDB interval converted to station TT with station_time.tdb_minus_tt at each site: |difference| < 8e-10 s (the neglected (V^2/c^2 + 2U/c^2)|tau| bound; verifies the first-order terms, ~2.7 us, to 3e-4); 20 epochs, two baselines
gates.G8_gravity_vs_moyer: T_grav (Sun, Earth) vs the difference of Moyer eq. 8-38 one-way Shapiro delays (rlt.shapiro_delay_s) for a source 1e16 m along -K to each station: |difference| < 1e-12 s
gates.G9_clock_cancellation: with clock offsets (b_A, b_B) = (1e-6, -2e-6) s each delay moves by ~3e-6 s; delta_dor_ssb moves by < 1e-11 s
gates.G10_jacobian: delta_dor_ssb state partial vs Richardson central FD of delta_dor_ssb over the arc-initial state: relative error < 1e-6 per row on a 1 h arc
gates.G11_legacy_unchanged: legacy delta_dor functions bitwise unchanged; delta_dor_ssb minus the legacy observable recorded on the survey geometry (informational)
gates.G12_fail_closed: delta_dor_ssb with station_time != 'FULL_TOPOCENTRIC' or a missing site raises ValueError

G13_regression: full regression green; every changed pin and protected file listed
out_of_scope: quasar media (troposphere/ionosphere along the quasar line of sight), quasar structure, the full DSN delta-DOR processing chain; estimator wiring of delta-DOR (no production estimator consumes delta-DOR); rerunning the Phase 17 R1O-OPT / R1OD studies (their scripts are byte-pinned; they used MOON_PA and the legacy delta-DOR)
reject_if: a gate fails as computed; a changed tolerance after a result goes to docs/assurance/amendment-log.md and the result is exploratory

results_slice_1.G1: PASS first run: 3.6e-11 (no bias), 3.9e-11 (1 mrad bias) vs FD with the attitude rebuilt; before: 5.8% (no such Jacobian)
results_slice_1.G3: PASS first run (ME bitwise to pxform; PA bitwise to before; normal 1e-15; displacement in band)
results_slice_1.behaviour_change: landmark_inertial_position_m / landmark_surface_outward_normal_j2000 default frame PA -> ME; byte-pinned Phase 17 study scripts calling the default now get ME (archived results used PA)

G7.preregistered: FAIL as computed: consensus vs BCRS plane-wave oracle 1.13e-9 s > 8e-10 (Madrid-Canberra; Goldstone-Canberra passed)
G7.diagnosis: not proportional to tau; 0.47-0.69 ns from the oracle's ERFA dtdb topocentric term (vs the exact V.b/c^2 between DSN complexes), the rest the (2U + V^2)/c^2 scale terms of Galilean station positions; consequence: with a dtdb spacecraft term and an exact-V consensus quasar term delta-DOR is inconsistent by 0.62-0.73 ns
G7.design_change: owner said 'do your best'; agent decision, owner approval pending: delta_dor_ssb computes the quasar term in the same light-time model as the spacecraft term (quasar_delay_station_time); quasar_delay_consensus stays as the independent IERS 2010 check
G7.amended_gate: same-model minus consensus (gravity off) < |dtdb error| + (2U/c^2 + V^2/c^2)|b|/c + 1e-11 s: PASS; after removing the dtdb error 0.08 ns (Goldstone-Canberra), 0.82 ns (Madrid-Canberra)

results_slice_2.G8: PASS first run: consensus T_grav vs Moyer eq. 8-38 differential for a source at 1e16 m: 1.2e-14 s
results_slice_2.G9: PASS first run: delta-DOR moves 3.4e-14 / 4.5e-14 s under (1e-6, -2e-6) s clocks

G10.diagnosis: the test fixture's station provider evaluated et0 + t, quantised at ulp(et0) ~ 1.2e-7 s; the FD shift of t_B (~1e-9 s) left station B frozen and the FD missed the v_B/c term; not the STM nor the event partial (an exact linear STM perturbation gives the same 1.03e-6)
G10.fix: fixture moves the station by velocity x the exact rounding error (as BarycentricEphemeris._ssb_state); gate unchanged: PASS 7.7e-8 to 3.9e-7

results_slice_2.G11: PASS (legacy bitwise vs values recorded from the pre-change module with the corrected fixture); informational: delta_dor_ssb minus legacy 668-785 ns on Goldstone-Canberra (studies/phase17/results/wp2_6_gate_values.json)
